storage: Keep in an airtight container in a cool, dry cupboard; use within about a year. Cooked rice goes in the fridge within an hour and is eaten within 1 to 2 days.
looksLike: Long, slender, slightly pale white grains that lengthen a lot when cooked and smell faintly nutty.
howToPick: Long, unbroken, evenly coloured grains with a mild fragrance; few broken bits or powder in the pack. Avoid damp-smelling or insect-damaged rice. Older (aged) rice costs more and cooks drier and longer.
shelfLife: About a year in a sealed pack (general guidance; not taken from a source in this run).
substitutes: Other long-grain rice (sona masuri, jeera rice)

usedIn.raw: 70 g dry basmati rice per serving.
